# AI Router - Project Context File

**Last Updated:** Auto-generated by Claude
**Project Type:** TypeScript/Node.js API Server
**Purpose:** Ollama-compatible API bridge for multiple AI providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic)

---

## Project Overview

This project is an Ollama-compatible API bridge that allows users to interact with multiple AI providers (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) through a unified Ollama API interface. It runs on port 11434 (default Ollama port) and provides drop-in compatibility with existing Ollama clients.

### Key Features
- Multi-provider support (Gemini Web via Puppeteer, Gemini API, OpenAI, Anthropic)
- Streaming response support
- Request queuing with rate limiting
- Session persistence for browser automation
- Retry logic with fallback providers
- Prometheus-compatible metrics
- Kubernetes health probes

---

## Architecture

```
src/
├── index.ts                 # Express server entry point
├── types/
│   └── index.ts             # TypeScript type definitions
├── providers/
│   ├── index.ts             # ProviderFactory (singleton pattern)
│   ├── base.ts              # Abstract BaseProvider class
│   ├── geminiWeb.ts         # Puppeteer-based Gemini access
│   ├── geminiApi.ts         # Google Generative AI SDK
│   └── openaiCompatible.ts  # OpenAI SDK (also for Anthropic)
├── routes/
│   ├── api.ts               # Ollama-compatible API endpoints
│   ├── health.ts            # Health check endpoints
│   └── metrics.ts           # Prometheus metrics endpoints
├── middleware/
│   └── errorHandler.ts      # Express error handling
└── utils/
    ├── config.ts            # Configuration loading
    ├── configValidator.ts   # Zod-based config validation
    ├── logger.ts            # Winston logging
    ├── modelRouter.ts       # Model-to-provider routing
    ├── requestQueue.ts      # Rate limiting queue
    ├── retryHandler.ts      # Retry with fallback logic
    ├── sessionManager.ts    # Browser session persistence
    └── metrics.ts           # Metrics collection
```

## Dependencies

### Production
- `@google/generative-ai` - Google's official Gemini SDK
- `openai` - OpenAI SDK (also used for Anthropic via compatible endpoint)
- `puppeteer` + `puppeteer-extra` + `puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth` - Browser automation
- `express` + `cors` + `helmet` + `morgan` - HTTP server
- `express-rate-limit` - Rate limiting middleware
- `winston` - Logging
- `zod` - Schema validation
- `dotenv` - Environment variable loading

### Development
- TypeScript 5.7+, ts-node-dev, eslint, jest

## API Endpoints

### Ollama-Compatible
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/tags` | GET | List available models |
| `/api/generate` | POST | Generate text completion |
| `/api/chat` | POST | Chat completion |
| `/api/embed` | POST | Generate embeddings |
| `/api/pull` | POST | Pull model (no-op) |
| `/api/show` | POST | Show model info |
| `/api/delete` | DELETE | Delete model (no-op) |
| `/api/copy` | POST | Copy model (not supported) |
| `/api/create` | POST | Create model (not supported) |

### Bridge-Specific
| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/` | GET | API documentation |
| `/health` | GET | Overall health check |
| `/health/providers` | GET | Provider status |
| `/health/queue` | GET | Queue status |
| `/health/sessions` | GET | Session status |
| `/health/ready` | GET | K8s readiness probe |
| `/health/live` | GET | K8s liveness probe |
| `/metrics` | GET | Prometheus metrics |
| `/metrics/json` | GET | JSON metrics |
| `/metrics/summary` | GET | Metrics summary |
| `/metrics/reset` | POST | Reset metrics (admin) |

## Model Routing

Models are routed to providers based on:
1. Exact match in `modelMappings` array
2. Direct match with provider's supported models
3. Prefix-based routing (gemini-*, gpt-*, claude*)
4. Fallback to highest-priority enabled provider

### Model Mappings
| Ollama Model | Provider | Actual Model |
|--------------|----------|--------------|
| `gemini`, `gemini-pro`, `gemini-ultra` | gemini-web | Various |
| `gemini-flash`, `gemini-1.5-flash`, `gemini-1.5-pro` | gemini-api | Latest versions |
| `gpt-4o`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `gpt-4`, `gpt-3.5-turbo` | openai | Same names |
| `claude`, `claude-sonnet`, `claude-opus`, `claude-haiku` | anthropic | Full model names |

---

## Provider Configuration

### Gemini Web (Puppeteer)
- Uses `puppeteer-extra` with stealth plugin
- Supports manual login or automated login with credentials
- Session persistence via cookies/localStorage
- Rate limited: 2 concurrent, 10/min, 200/hour

### Gemini API
- Uses `@google/generative-ai` SDK
- Supports embeddings via `embedding-001` model
- Rate limited: 5 concurrent, 60/min, 1000/hour

### OpenAI / Anthropic
- Uses `openai` SDK with configurable base URL
- Supports embeddings via `text-embedding-3-small`
- Rate limited: 5 concurrent (OpenAI), 3 concurrent (Anthropic)

## Identified Issues and Bugs

### Fixed Issues (Session Date: Current)

1. **requestQueue.ts:406 - Cleanup interval bug** ✅ FIXED
   - Bug: Map iteration was incorrectly using values as keys
   - Fix: Properly iterate over Map entries with `[provider, timestamps]`

2. **retryHandler.ts - Fallback operation always returned null** ✅ FIXED
   - Bug: `createFallbackOperation` method was incomplete
   - Fix: Added `createFallbackOperation` callback parameter to `executeWithRetry` and implemented proper fallback logic in `executeChatCompletion` and `executeStreamingChatCompletion`

3. **sessionManager.ts - Used `any` type for Puppeteer page** ✅ FIXED
   - Bug: Missing proper typing for Puppeteer Page objects
   - Fix: Added proper imports for `Page` and `Cookie` types from puppeteer

4. **config.ts - Anthropic required both API key AND base URL** ✅ FIXED
   - Bug: Unusual requirement for base URL when Anthropic has a standard endpoint
   - Fix: Set default `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to `https://api.anthropic.com/v1`

5. **geminiApi.ts - System messages converted to user messages** ✅ FIXED
   - Bug: Gemini API supports system instructions natively
   - Fix: Added `extractSystemInstruction` method and pass `systemInstruction` to `getGenerativeModel`

6. **Missing input validation for image data** ✅ FIXED
   - Added new `src/utils/imageValidator.ts` with comprehensive image validation
   - Added validation in `/api/generate` and `/api/chat` endpoints

### Remaining Issues

7. **No test files exist despite Jest configuration**

8. **Anthropic provider uses OpenAI-compatible mode only**
    - Should support native Anthropic API for better compatibility

## Environment Variables

```env
# Server
PORT=11434
NODE_ENV=development
LOG_LEVEL=info

# Gemini Web
GEMINI_WEB_ENABLED=true
GOOGLE_EMAIL=
GOOGLE_PASSWORD=
CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH=
PUPPETEER_HEADLESS=true

# Gemini API
GEMINI_API_KEY=
GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL=gemini-1.5-flash-latest

# OpenAI
OPENAI_API_KEY=
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1
OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini

# Anthropic
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=
ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL=claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022

# Rate Limiting
RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS=60000
RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS=100
REQUEST_TIMEOUT=300000

# Streaming
STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE=1024
STREAM_DELAY_MS=10
```

## Build & Run

```bash
# Development
npm install

# Production
npm run build
npm start

# Docker
docker build -t ai-router .
docker run -p 11434:11434 --env-file .env ai-router
```
